changeSet.author: nexus-ft04v.2
changeSet.comment: embedding_models: install-scoped reference table of models this engine can serve (RDR-204 Technical Design 1). No tenant_id, no RLS — same posture as service_tokens/install_pings (telemetry-014's file header): this table holds install-wide configuration, not tenant-owned data, and every tenant reads the identical rows.
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.embedding_models CASCADE

changeSet.author: nexus-ft04v.2
changeSet.comment: embedding_models seed: the four models this engine can serve today (RDR-204 Key Discoveries) — voyage-3 deliberately excluded (no client token, no live row).
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO nexus.embedding_models (embedding_model, dimension, provider) VALUES ('voyage-code-3', 1024, 'voyage'), ('voyage-context-3', 1024, 'voyage'), ('bge-base-en-v15-768', 768, 'onnx-local'), ('minilm-l6-v2-384', 384, 'onnx-local');
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM nexus.embedding_models WHERE embedding_model IN ('voyage-code-3', 'voyage-context-3', 'bge-base-en-v15-768', 'minilm-l6-v2-384')

changeSet.author: nexus-ft04v.2
changeSet.comment: embedding_profile: the install-scoped write-model choice per (tenant, content_type) (RDR-204 Technical Design 1). Tenant-scoped: RLS ENABLE+FORCE with the same tenant_isolation policy shape as catalog_collections/catalog_meta (catalog-001-baseline.xml changeset catalog-001-7).

changeSet.author: nexus-ft04v.2
changeSet.comment: catalog_collections: nullable dimension + lifecycle_state columns (RDR-204 Technical Design 2/3). Both NULLABLE at this step, no CHECK, no DEFAULT, no FK — the backfill walk (bead nexus-ft04v.4, hygiene-001-6 shape) populates every row and adds the constraints in the SAME changeset as the walk, so a constraining changeset never meets a blank row.
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE nexus.catalog_collections DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS lifecycle_state; ALTER TABLE nexus.catalog_collections DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS dimension;
